growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the release and 10-K; the inference that the drag ends after the exit is drawn from the 10-K wording.
growth_thesis.claim: The Portable Medical exit is a drag on total sales that ends once the wind-down finishes. Other Markets sales were $11 million against $21 million a year earlier. Growth in the remaining lines needs to outrun this fading drag.
quotes: Other Markets sales totaled $11 million in the third quarter 2026, compared to $21 million in the third quarter 2025, primarily due to the Portable Medical exit.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-K and release; what must be true is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Management said in the 10-K that lower-than-anticipated adoption of three new products would weigh on sales growth. Growth resumes only if adoption of those products improves, and the evidence shows no sign of this yet.
quotes: In 2026, we expect sales growth to be impacted by lower sales related to three new products due to lower than anticipated market adoption.

growth_thesis.basis: Figures are stated in the income statement; the mechanism is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Sales growth has not converted into profit. Cost of sales rose to 348,100 from 341,531 while sales fell to 449,661 from 467,691 in the latest quarter (table in thousands). Earnings growth would need costs to fall in line with volume.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the release.
growth_thesis.claim: The pending KKR-affiliate acquisition at $127 in cash per share is anticipated to close by the end of the year, and management is giving no financial outlook. Any future growth path is therefore not guided in the public record.
quotes: the Company is not providing a financial outlook and will not host a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results.

material_events.basis: stated in the cited items (10-Q MD&A and the earnings release)
material_events.claim: Integer signed a merger agreement to be acquired by affiliates of KKR-managed funds, with each share converted into $127 in cash. The stockholders approved adopting the agreement, and the HSR waiting period ended early. Closing is anticipated by year-end, subject to remaining conditions including regulatory approvals.
quotes: The Transaction is anticipated to close by the end of 2026, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of customary closing conditions specified in the Merger Agreement, including the receipt of required regulatory approvals.
on October 21, 2026, Integer's stockholders approved the adoption of the Merger Agreement
